Game Overview

Newee Ball is a adventure title where guide a lively ball through eight increasingly difficult landscapes in Newee Ball. Collect lollipops, dodge dangerous obstacles, and outsmart hostile balls. Master the double jump to reach new heights and plan your moves carefully to succeed in this captivating 2D adventure. Victory awaits at each exiting doorway!
